---
title: "Already released"
---

This page has a release date of **2020-01-01**. With the normal system-time
configuration, it is part of every current public render.

Its visibility comes directly from its past date; it has no manual `draft`
override.

## Shared-source teaching example

What is the release date of this page?

::: {teaching="exercise"}
Complete the statement: this page was released on **____-__-__**.
:::

::: {teaching="solution"}
Completed statement: this page was released on **2020-01-01**.
:::

::: {.callout-solution title="Why this page is public"}
The page date is earlier than the schedule's comparison date and there is no
manual override, so `scheduled-docs` classifies it as published.
:::
